title: ONB-UI-04 success-path rendered onboarding_timeout failed state due premature stale-pending timeout window
resolution: Partial mitigation applied: onboarding stale-pending timeout window increased from 90s to 240s to avoid premature timeout classification for valid long-running success flows while retaining stale-pending timeout fallback semantics.

root_cause.summary: Timeout fallback logic in onboarding selectors classified pending records older than 90 seconds as failed with onboarding_timeout. Real onboarding success flows can exceed 90 seconds under live Keycloak + schema provisioning latency, causing the success-path UI assertion to see failed timeout state.

follow_up: Re-run focused ONB-UI-04 E2E in stable terminal session and capture terminal pass/fail output
If still failing, inspect onboarding progression record by onboarding_id and correlate state transition latency with completion-gate checks
